<a id="BodyAt"></a>

### The body between two poses

`BodyAt` · `src/body.ts:637` · status: **held**

Part of the way from one pose to the next: the pelvis and the spine in proportion; each leg on its foot where the foot stays, stepping where it goes elsewhere; each hand on its way, its wrist above the floor, its elbow pointing back and a little outward; the foot, the toes and the hand turning in proportion.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ m, mv, g, trunkOf, feet, stepping, footWay, planted, handWay, twoBones }) => (from: Keyframe, to: Keyframe, t: number): Body => {
    const { add, sub, mul, dot, len, unit, mix, mix3 } = g
    const [along0, high0] = from.pelvis
    const [along1, high1] = to.pelvis
    const pelvis: readonly [number, number] = [mix(along0, along1, t), mix(high0, high1, t)]
    const spine = from.spine.map((v, i) => mix(v, to.spine[i], t)) as unknown as readonly [number, number, number, number]
    const trunk = trunkOf(pelvis, spine)
    const side = (onLeft: boolean): Side => {
      const hipOf = (k: Trunk) => (onLeft ? k.hipL : k.hipR)
      const shoulderOf = (k: Trunk) => (onLeft ? k.shoulderL : k.shoulderR)
      // The leg: on its foot if the foot stays, stepping if it goes elsewhere.
      const f0 = onLeft ? from.legs.L : from.legs.R
      const f1 = onLeft ? to.legs.L : to.legs.R
      const hip = hipOf(trunk)
      const { along: footAlong, up: footUp, toesAlong, below } = feet(mix(f0.foot, f1.foot, t), mix(f0.toes, f1.toes, t))
      const moving = len(sub(f0.at, f1.at)) >= mv.still
      const leg = moving
        ? stepping(hip, footWay(f0.at, f1.at, { joint: Point.hip, from: hipOf(from.trunk), to: hipOf(to.trunk), now: hip }, t), below)
        : planted(hip, { at: mix3(f0.at, f1.at, t), foot: mix(f0.foot, f1.foot, t), toes: mix(f0.toes, f1.toes, t) })
      const ankle = leg.ankle
      const heel = add(add(ankle, mul(footUp, -m.heelDown)), mul(footAlong, -m.heelBack))
      const ball = add(add(ankle, mul(footUp, -m.ballDown)), mul(footAlong, m.ballForward))
      // The arm.
      const h0 = onLeft ? from.arms.L : from.arms.R
      const h1 = onLeft ? to.arms.L : to.arms.R
      const shoulder = shoulderOf(trunk)
      const reach = handWay(h0.at, h1.at, { joint: Point.shoulder, from: shoulderOf(from.trunk), to: shoulderOf(to.trunk), now: shoulder }, t)
      const wristAim: Vec = g.at(g.along(reach), Math.max(g.height(reach), mv.wristFloor), g.across(reach))
      const w = sub(wristAim, shoulder)
      const back: Vec = g.planar(w) < mv.folded ? g.backward : g.face(w)
      const armPole = add(unit(back), g.right(onLeft ? -mv.elbowsOut : mv.elbowsOut))
      const arm = twoBones(shoulder, wristAim, m.upperArm, m.forearm, armPole)
      const handAlong = g.toward(mix(h0.hand, h1.hand, t))
      const across = unit(mix3(g.rightward, g.normal(handAlong), mix(h0.palm, h1.palm, t)))
      return {
        hip, knee: leg.knee, ankle, heel, ball, toe: add(ball, mul(toesAlong, m.toes)), footAlong, footUp, toesAlong,
        shoulder, elbow: arm.middle, wrist: arm.end, tip: add(arm.end, mul(handAlong, m.hand)), handAlong,
        handAcross: unit(sub(across, mul(handAlong, dot(across, handAlong)))),
        legReach: leg.reach, armReach: arm.reach,
      }
    }
    return { ...trunk, L: side(true), R: side(false), nose: add(trunk.head, mul(trunk.face, m.nose)) }
  }
```

</details>

<a id="FootOnItsWay"></a>

### A foot on its way

`FootOnItsWay` · `src/body.ts:562` · status: **held**

Where a foot is, part of the way between two poses, as the page "Salutation au soleil" moves it: one that moves less than the still distance goes straight; otherwise it turns around its hip as the hip moves, its distance to it changing in proportion, never lower than the lowest of its two places nor than its floor height, and a foot that steps far is lifted half way.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ mv, g, angles, counts }) => (from: Vec, to: Vec, around: Around<Point.hip>, t: number): Vec => {
    const { sub, len, mix, height, along, across } = g
    if (len(sub(from, to)) < mv.still) return g.mix3(from, to, t)
    // A foot below the hip is read from behind past straight up, so that its way turns down, not over the head.
    const angle = (v: Vec) => {
      const a = g.heading(v)
      return a > angles.wrapAbove ? a - g.turn : a
    }
    const hip = around.now
    const r0 = sub(from, around.from)
    const r1 = sub(to, around.to)
    const d = g.toward(mix(angle(r0), angle(r1), t))
    const l = mix(g.planar(r0), g.planar(r1), t)
    const stride = Math.hypot(along(to) - along(from), across(to) - across(from))
    const lift = stride > mv.stride ? mv.lift * g.arch(t) : counts.zero
    return g.at(along(hip) + along(d) * l, Math.max(height(hip) + height(d) * l, Math.min(height(from), height(to), mv.footFloor)) + lift, mix(across(from), across(to), t))
  }
```

</details>

<a id="HandOnItsWay"></a>

### A hand on its way

`HandOnItsWay` · `src/body.ts:430` · status: **held**

Where a hand is, part of the way between two poses: one that moves less than the still distance goes straight; otherwise it turns around its shoulder as the shoulder moves, its distance to it changing in proportion, never lower than the lowest of its two places; and a place on the floor it leaves or comes to shapes its way: it is low only near it, leaving it and coming down onto it at the landing slope, so that it never slides on the floor.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ mv, g }) => (from: Vec, to: Vec, shoulder: Around<Point.shoulder>, t: number): Vec => {
    const { sub, len, mix, height, along, across } = g
    if (len(sub(from, to)) < mv.still) return g.mix3(from, to, t)
    const base = shoulder.now
    const r0 = sub(from, shoulder.from)
    const r1 = sub(to, shoulder.to)
    const d = g.toward(mix(g.heading(r0), g.heading(r1), t))
    const l = mix(g.planar(r0), g.planar(r1), t)
    const x = along(base) + along(d) * l
    const z = mix(across(from), across(to), t)
    // Only a place on the floor shapes the way: the hand leaves it and comes down onto it from above.
    const rise = (place: Vec) =>
      height(place) <= mv.wristFloor + mv.still ? height(place) + Math.min(mv.landing * Math.hypot(x - along(place), z - across(place)), mv.clearance) : -Infinity
    const rises = [rise(from), rise(to)].filter((r) => r > -Infinity)
    return g.at(x, Math.max(height(base) + height(d) * l, Math.min(height(from), height(to)), rises.length ? Math.min(...rises) : -Infinity), z)
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax

<a id="KeyOf"></a>

### A pose ready to move

`KeyOf` · `src/body.ts:378` · status: **held**

A pose placed on the mat for a round: in a pose that sets the legs apart, the leg that leads the round takes the stance the step gives it, the other leg the other; the right side to the right of the middle, the left side to the left; hands raised from the shoulders placed from the trunk. Alone, a pose is seen as the right leg would lead it, stepping back.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ trunkOf, g, sides, texts }) => (shape: Shape, leading: Leg = Leg.right, stance: Stance = Stance.back): Keyframe => {
    const trunk = trunkOf(shape.pelvis, shape.spine)
    const other = (s: Stance) => (s === Stance.front ? Stance.back : Stance.front)
    const legs = Stance.front in shape.legs ? (shape.legs as Record<Stance, LegShape>) : { front: shape.legs as LegShape, back: shape.legs as LegShape }
    const right = leading === Leg.right ? legs[stance] : legs[other(stance)]
    const left = leading === Leg.right ? legs[other(stance)] : legs[stance]
    // A point written for the right side, mirrored across the mat for the left.
    const placed = ([along, high, across]: Vec, onLeft: boolean): Vec => g.add(g.point(along, high), g.right(onLeft ? -across : across))
    const foot = (l: LegShape, onLeft: boolean): FootKey => ({ at: placed(l.at, onLeft), foot: l.foot, toes: l.toes })
    const { at, fromShoulders } = shape.arms as Partial<{ at: Vec; fromShoulders: { angle: number; reach: number; apart: number } }>
    const { hand: handTurn, palm } = shape.arms
    const hand = (onLeft: boolean, shoulder: Vec): HandKey => {
      if (at !== undefined || fromShoulders === undefined) return { at: placed(at ?? g.down, onLeft), hand: handTurn, palm }
      const reach = g.mul(g.toward(fromShoulders.angle), fromShoulders.reach)
      return { at: placed([g.along(shoulder) + g.along(reach), g.height(shoulder) + g.height(reach), fromShoulders.apart], onLeft), hand: handTurn, palm }
    }
    const named = (side: string) => (r: string) => [side, r].join(texts.space)
    const rests = [...(shape.rests ?? []), ...(right.rests ?? []).map(named(sides.right)), ...(left.rests ?? []).map(named(sides.left))]
    return {
      pelvis: shape.pelvis, spine: shape.spine, trunk, rests,
      legs: { L: foot(left, true), R: foot(right, false) },
      arms: { L: hand(true, trunk.shoulderL), R: hand(false, trunk.shoulderR) },
    }
  }
```

</details>

<a id="LimbsReach"></a>

### Every limb reaches

`LimbsReach` · `src/body.ts:823` · status: **held**

In a pose, each arm reaches its hand and each leg its foot: where a pose puts a hand or a foot farther than the limb is long, the limb would be stretched straight short of it, and the pose would not be the one written. It gives how far the farthest limb reaches, as a part of its length.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ keyOf, bodyAt, counts }) => (shape: Shape): number => {
    const k = keyOf(shape)
    const b = bodyAt(k, k, counts.zero)
    return Math.max(b.L.legReach, b.R.legReach, b.L.armReach, b.R.armReach)
  }
```

</details>

<a id="PlantedLeg"></a>

### A leg on its foot

`PlantedLeg` · `src/body.ts:521` · status: **held**

A leg whose foot stands where it is put, at its angles: the ankle raised if any point of the sole, the top of the foot or the ankle would go under the floor, the knee bending forward, and the foot raised again if the knee would sink deeper than the mat gives.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ m, mv, g, feet, twoBones, lift, counts }) => (hip: Vec, foot: FootKey): { knee: Vec; ankle: Vec; reach: number } => {
    const { height, along, across } = g
    const { below } = feet(foot.foot, foot.toes)
    const legTo = (target: Vec) => {
      const pole = g.normal(g.sub(target, hip))
      return twoBones(hip, target, m.thigh, m.shin, g.len(pole) < g.tolerance ? g.toward(counts.zero) : pole)
    }
    let aim: Vec = g.at(along(foot.at), Math.max(height(foot.at), below), across(foot.at))
    let leg = legTo(aim)
    // A knee that would sink into the mat lifts the foot's aim, a few times at most.
    for (let pass: number = counts.zero; pass < lift.passes && height(leg.middle) - m.kneeSurface < -mv.kneeGive; pass = counts.next(pass)) {
      aim = g.add(aim, g.point(counts.zero, lift.overshoot * (m.kneeSurface - mv.kneeGive - height(leg.middle))))
      leg = legTo(aim)
    }
    return { knee: leg.middle, ankle: leg.end, reach: leg.reach }
  }
```

</details>

<a id="RestsOnWhatItNames"></a>

### A pose rests on what it names

`RestsOnWhatItNames` · `src/body.ts:778` · status: **held**

The points of the body's surface within touching distance of the floor are exactly those the pose names: a whole foot is its heel, its ball and its toes, the toes alone leave the heel up, the top of the foot is its top, a hand flat is the wrist and the fingertips, the chest and the pelvis their lowest curve, the head its own. It gives what is wrong: the points named that do not touch, the points that touch unnamed.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ keyOf, bodyAt, surfaces, points, sides, touching, texts, counts }) => (shape: Shape): { notTouching: string[]; unnamed: string[] } => {
    const k = keyOf(shape)
    const heights = surfaces(bodyAt(k, k, counts.zero))
    const at = (side: string) => (point: string) => [side, point].join(texts.space)
    const ofBody = (rest: BodyRest) => (points.sided.includes(rest) ? [sides.left, sides.right].flatMap((side) => points.body[rest].map(at(side))) : points.body[rest])
    const named = new Set(k.rests.flatMap((r) => {
      const [side, rest] = r.split(texts.space)
      return rest === undefined ? ofBody(side as BodyRest) : points.leg[rest as LegRest].map(at(side))
    }))
    const touches = (n: string) => heights[n] <= touching.within
    return {
      notTouching: [...named].filter((n) => !touches(n)),
      unnamed: Object.keys(heights).filter((n) => touches(n) && !named.has(n)),
    }
  }
```

</details>

<a id="SidesOf"></a>

### The legs in front and behind

`SidesOf` · `src/body.ts:885` · status: **held**

In a pose that sets the legs apart, the leg that leads the round is in front when its stance says so, the other behind; in a pose with the feet together, the leg that leads is said in front.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ sides }) => (leading: Leg, stance?: Stance): Sides => {
    const lead = (leading === Leg.right ? sides.right : sides.left) as Sides["front"]
    const other = (leading === Leg.right ? sides.left : sides.right) as Sides["front"]
    return stance === Stance.back ? { front: other, back: lead } : { front: lead, back: other }
  }
```

</details>

<a id="SpotOn"></a>

### Where a spot is

`SpotOn` · `src/body.ts:911` · status: **held**

The point a spot names on a body: a joint on its side (half way between both sides when it says both, or no side), a point of the trunk; on the floor below it if it says so (a centimetre above, to be seen); moved by its shift.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ g, places, names }) => (body: Body, spot: Spot, sides: Sides): Vec => {
    const trunk: Partial<Record<Point, Vec>> = {
      [Point.pelvis]: body.pelvis, [Point.waist]: body.waist, [Point.neckBase]: body.neckBase, [Point.shoulders]: body.shoulders,
      [Point.neckTop]: body.neckTop, [Point.head]: body.head, [Point.nose]: body.nose,
      [Point.sternum]: g.mix3(body.waist, body.neckBase, places.sternum),
    }
    const joint = (onLeft: boolean) => (onLeft ? body.L : body.R)[spot.at as keyof Side] as Vec
    const onLeft = (side: Which): boolean =>
      side === Which.left || (side === Which.front && sides.front === names.left) || (side === Which.back && sides.back === names.left)
    const named = trunk[spot.at]
    const p = named ?? (spot.side === undefined || spot.side === Which.both ? g.mix3(joint(true), joint(false), places.between) : joint(onLeft(spot.side)))
    const down: Vec = spot.floor ? g.at(g.along(p), places.aboveFloor, g.across(p)) : p
    return spot.shift ? g.add(down, spot.shift) : down
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `g` ← [The space of the mat](#MatSpace) · `places` ← [Where a spot of the body is](#SpotPlaces) · `names` ← [The names of the sides](#SideNames)
- Refines: [Practise yoga on one's own, guided](product.md#PractiseGuided)
- Used by: [A landmark on the body](marks.md#MarkOnBody)

<a id="SteppingLeg"></a>

### A leg that steps

`SteppingLeg` · `src/body.ts:606` · status: **held**

A leg whose foot is on its way reaches it as the page "Salutation au soleil" moves it: the ankle raised if the sole would go under the floor, the knee bending forward. Its knee may pass into the mat on the way, up to the depth a step may sink: the foot keeps its way and its pace.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ m, g, twoBones, counts }) => (hip: Vec, aim: Vec, footBelow: number): { knee: Vec; ankle: Vec; reach: number } => {
    const target: Vec = g.at(g.along(aim), Math.max(g.height(aim), footBelow), g.across(aim))
    const normal = g.normal(g.sub(target, hip))
    const pole = g.len(normal) < g.tolerance ? g.toward(counts.zero) : normal
    const leg = twoBones(hip, target, m.thigh, m.shin, pole)
    return { knee: leg.middle, ankle: leg.end, reach: leg.reach }
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `m` ← [Measures of the body](#BodyMeasures) · `g` ← [The space of the mat](#MatSpace) · `twoBones` ← [A limb reaches its end](#TwoBones) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [Practise yoga on one's own, guided](product.md#PractiseGuided)
- Used by: [The body between two poses](#BodyAt)
- Verified by: [The body stays on the floor](scenarios.md#BodyStaysOnTheFloor)

<a id="SurfaceHeights"></a>

### The heights of the body's surface

`SurfaceHeights` · `src/body.ts:729` · status: **held**

The points of the body's surface that may rest on the floor, by name, and their height: the pelvis and the chest at the lowest of their curves, the head, and for each side the heel, the ball, the toes, the top of the foot, the knee, the wrist and the fingertips.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ m, g, sides, texts }) => (body: Body): Record<string, number> => {
    const { add, mul, height } = g
    const lowest = (centre: Vec, across: Vec, along: Vec, a: number, b: number) => height(centre) - Math.hypot(a * height(across), b * height(along))
    const heights: Record<string, number> = {
      [Point.pelvis]: lowest(add(body.pelvis, mul(body.lowerBack, m.pelvisUp)), g.face(body.lowerBack), body.lowerBack, m.pelvisAcross, m.pelvisAlong),
      [Surface.chest]: lowest(add(body.waist, mul(body.chest, m.chestUp)), g.face(body.chest), body.chest, m.chestAcross, m.chestAlong),
      [Point.head]: height(body.head) - m.headSurface,
    }
    for (const [side, x] of [[sides.left, body.L], [sides.right, body.R]] as const) {
      const at = (point: string) => [side, point].join(texts.space)
      heights[at(Point.heel)] = height(x.heel)
      heights[at(Point.ball)] = height(x.ball)
      heights[at(Point.toe)] = height(x.toe)
      heights[at(Surface.top)] = height(x.ankle) + m.topUp * height(x.footUp) + m.topForward * height(x.footAlong)
      heights[at(Point.knee)] = height(x.knee) - m.kneeSurface
      heights[at(Point.wrist)] = height(x.wrist) - m.wristSurface
      heights[at(Point.tip)] = height(x.tip) - m.wristSurface
    }
    return heights
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `m` ← [Measures of the body](#BodyMeasures) · `g` ← [The space of the mat](#MatSpace) · `sides` ← [The names of the sides](#SideNames) · `texts` ← [Texts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Texts)
- Refines: [Practise yoga on one's own, guided](product.md#PractiseGuided)
- Used by: [A pose rests on what it names](#RestsOnWhatItNames), [The body stays on the floor](scenarios.md#BodyStaysOnTheFloor), [Sequences drawn by lot](scenarios.md#DrawnSequencesMakeSense)
- Verified by: [The body stays on the floor](scenarios.md#BodyStaysOnTheFloor)
- Used by: [Criteria of a sequence that makes sense](content.md#MakesSenseCriteria)

<a id="TrunkOf"></a>

### The trunk from its angles

`TrunkOf` · `src/body.ts:272` · status: **held**

From the pelvis on the mat and the four angles of the spine: the waist at the end of the lower back, the base of the neck at the end of the chest, the shoulders a little below it, the top of the neck, the middle of the head; the face turned forward from the head's direction; the shoulders and the hips their half-widths to each side.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ m, g }) => (pelvis: readonly [number, number], spine: readonly [number, number, number, number]): Trunk => {
    const { add, mul, toward } = g
    const [alongMat, high] = pelvis
    const p: Vec = g.point(alongMat, high)
    const [lowerBack, chest, neck, headTilt] = spine.map((a) => toward(a))
    const waist = add(p, mul(lowerBack, m.lowerBack))
    const neckBase = add(waist, mul(chest, m.chest))
    const shoulders = add(neckBase, mul(chest, -m.shoulderDrop))
    const neckTop = add(neckBase, mul(neck, m.neck))
    return {
      pelvis: p, waist, neckBase, shoulders, neckTop, head: add(neckTop, mul(headTilt, m.head)), face: g.face(headTilt),
      lowerBack, chest, neck, headTilt,
      shoulderL: add(shoulders, g.right(-m.shoulders)), shoulderR: add(shoulders, g.right(m.shoulders)),
      hipL: add(p, g.right(-m.hips)), hipR: add(p, g.right(m.hips)),
    }
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `m` ← [Measures of the body](#BodyMeasures) · `g` ← [The space of the mat](#MatSpace)
- Refines: [Practise yoga on one's own, guided](product.md#PractiseGuided)
- Used by: [The body between two poses](#BodyAt), [A pose ready to move](#KeyOf)
- Verified by: [The body stays on the floor](scenarios.md#BodyStaysOnTheFloor)

<a id="TwoBones"></a>

### A limb reaches its end

`TwoBones` · `src/body.ts:315` · status: **held**

Two segments from a joint toward a target: the end goes as far as the segments reach (never quite straight, never folded flat), the middle joint bends to the side the pole says; and how far the target is, as a part of the limb's length (more than 1: out of reach).

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ g, slack, counts }) => (from: Vec, target: Vec, first: number, second: number, pole: Vec): { middle: Vec; end: Vec; reach: number } => {
    const { add, sub, mul, dot, len, unit } = g
    const d = sub(target, from)
    const distance = len(d)
    const along: Vec = distance > g.tolerance ? unit(d) : g.down
    const kept = Math.max(Math.abs(first - second) + slack.folded, Math.min(first + second - slack.stretched, distance))
    const a = (first * first - second * second + kept * kept) / (kept + kept)
    const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(counts.zero, first * first - a * a))
    const side = sub(pole, mul(along, dot(pole, along)))
    const bend: Vec = len(side) < g.tolerance ? g.rightward : unit(side)
    return { middle: add(add(from, mul(along, a)), mul(bend, h)), end: add(from, mul(along, kept)), reach: distance / (first + second) }
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `g` ← [The space of the mat](#MatSpace) · `slack` ← [How far a limb keeps from flat](#LimbSlack) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [Practise yoga on one's own, guided](product.md#PractiseGuided)
- Used by: [The body between two poses](#BodyAt), [A leg on its foot](#PlantedLeg), [A leg that steps](#SteppingLeg)
- Verified by: [The body stays on the floor](scenarios.md#BodyStaysOnTheFloor)

| The middle joint bends toward the pole | passed |

<a id="Movement"></a>

### How a body moves

`Movement` · `src/body.ts:178`

Between two poses: a hand or a foot that moves less than two centimetres stays where it is (it goes straight); a foot that steps more than 35 cm is lifted 12 cm half way (only one foot steps that far at once: a way between levels that would move both is not one, requirement "A sequence that makes sense"), and goes no lower than 3 cm on its way; a hand leaves its place and comes down onto the next no flatter than 45°, and passes 4 cm above its places on its way, so that it never slides on the floor; a foot keeps its ankle 3 cm above the floor and every point of its sole on it or above; a knee resting sinks no more than 3.5 cm into the mat (the mannequin's knee is a ball bigger than a knee), and a knee passing over it during a step no more than 10 cm, as the page lets it; a wrist stays 3.5 cm above the floor; the elbows point a quarter outward; an arm nearly folded on itself bends backward.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| still | 0.02 |
| stride | 0.35 |
| lift | 0.12 |
| footFloor | 0.03 |
| landing | 1 |
| clearance | 0.04 |
| ankleClear | 0.03 |
| kneeGive | 0.04 |
| stepSink | 0.1 |
| wristFloor | 0.04 |
| elbowsOut | 0.25 |
| folded | 0.05 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: A foot coming down onto its place at 45°, like a hand, a foot stepping far rose 80 cm and swung around the hip; Raising the foot until the knee clears the mat, the leg stopped as the knee neared the mat, then caught up; Turning the thigh and the shin from one pose to the next, the foot went toward the hands, then forward between the arms; Turning the knee outward where it would sink, the knee swung 23 cm to the side
- Used by: [The body between two poses](#BodyAt), [A foot from its angles](#FootOf), [A foot on its way](#FootOnItsWay), [A hand on its way](#HandOnItsWay), [A leg on its foot](#PlantedLeg), [The body stays on the floor](scenarios.md#BodyStaysOnTheFloor), [Sequences drawn by lot](scenarios.md#DrawnSequencesMakeSense), [Holding the poses](scenarios.md#HoldThePoses)
